question: Add a context.Context parameter to the Matches method on the Selector interface in k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/labels. The labels.Selector interface is used pervasively across the Kubernetes ecosystem for filtering resources by label selectors. Changing Matches(Labels) bool to Matches(ctx context.Context, Labels) bool breaks all call sites that invoke .Matches() and all custom implementations of the Selector interface.
